select senid, time, MAX(ifch) AS ifch, MAX(factv) AS factv, MAX(cycle) AS cycle, MAX(state) AS state, MAX(ts) TS from rtev
and time >=to_date('${stime}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
and time <=to_date('${etime}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
and senid in
#{stcd}
AND MOD(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(time, 'MI')), 5) = 0 AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(time, 'SS')) = 0 GROUP BY senid, time order by time asc
